coding_logic.pseudocode:
def execute_spirit_of_fire_shaman(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Hao's great elemental spirit grows through soul consumption and manifests powerful flame-based effects.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    projectile = spawn_projectile(owner=actor,origin=launch_socket,aim=target)
    each_tick: projectile.move_using_swept_collision(delta_time)
    on_collision: validate_faction_and_hit_once(projectile,hit_target)
    apply_projectile_payload(hit_target,damage_or_status)
    despawn_on_hit_max_range_or_lifetime(projectile)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
